rationale: Transactional contacts ask about balances, payments, transfers, and movements: the account and payment inquiry workflow. Coarse: covers balance_inquiry, payment_status, and statement_request, so no single sub-intent applies

Product-servicing contacts concern existing products; cards are the servicing product with self-service actions (status, protective block). Assumed: the reason does not say which product, so the strict scenario maps it to other and the alternative scenario to credit

Complaint contacts include contested and unrecognized charges, and dispute is the only complaint-handling workflow in scope. Assumed: some complaints are about service or the app, so the strict scenario maps it to other

Commercial contacts are about offers and product information; the campaigns in the data promote credit cards and personal loans most. Assumed: the reason does not say credit, so the strict scenario maps it to other
Technical support (app, access, errors) is outside the four workflows
Retention (closing or keeping products) is outside the four workflows
